senses.gloss:
प्रयक्ष प्र-यक्ष, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. यक्ष्
with प्र), Ved. praiseworthy, laudable; (Sāy. =
पूज्य.)
प्रयच्छत् प्र-यच्छत्. See col. 2.

प्र-यच्छत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, presenting, giving,
bestowing.

प्रयज् 1. प्र-यज्, cl. 1. P. A. -यजति, -ते,
-यष्टुम्, Ved. to sacrifice to, offer sacrifices,
worship.

2. प्र-यज्, क्, f., Ved. an offering, oblation; [cf.
पृक्ष-प्˚.]

प्र-यज्यु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. to be worshipped or
honoured (Sāy. = प्रकर्षेण पूज्यः); striving
forwards, pressing onwards, rushing on (? cf. इयक्ष्;
especially used as an epithet of the Maruts and of
Vāyu, but also said of Indra and Agni).

प्र-याग, अस्, m. a sacrifice, an oblation; the
place of sacrifice ἐξοχήν, a celebrated place of
pilgrimage (now called Allahabad) at the confluence
of the Gaṅgā and Yamunā with the supposed sub-
terranean Sarasvatī (cf. त्रि-वेणी; प्रयाग in com-
position is applied to four other sacred places situated
at the confluence of two rivers, viz. Deva-p˚, Rudra-
p˚, Karṇa-p˚, and Nanda-p˚, in the Himālaya moun-
tains); a horse [cf. प्र-योग]; a N. of Indra [cf.
प्रयाग-भय]; N. of a man (in this sense also
प्रयागक); (आस्), m. pl. the inhabitants of Pra-
yāga.
—प्रयाग-भय, अस्, m. ‘fearing sacrifice,’
an epithet of Indra (who is liable to be dethroned
by the performance of a hundred Aśva-medhas or
horse sacrifices).
—प्रयाग-सेतु, उस्, m., N. of a
work.
प्रयाग प्र-याग. See 1. प्र-यज्, col. 1.

प्र-याज, अस्, m., Ved., N. of particular sacri-
ficial texts or invocations and of the Ājya oblations
or libations at which they are employed (they form
part of the Prāyaṇīya or introductory ceremony in a
Soma sacrifice and are generally five in number, viz.
Samidh, Tanū-napāt, Iḍā, Barhis, Svāhā-kāra; at
animal sacrifices their number is eleven, correspond-
ing to the eleven Āpris, cf. आ-प्री); a principal
ceremony or sacrifice.
—प्रयाज-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्,
Ved. accompanied with Prayājas.
प्रयाज प्र-याज. See 1. प्र-यज्, col. 1.

प्रयत् प्र-यत्, cl. 1. A. -यतते, -यतितुम्,
to strive, endeavour, make effort; to apply one's
self to (with loc.).

प्र-यतितव्य or प्र-यत्तव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to
be striven or endeavoured.

प्र-यत्न, अस्, m. persevering effort, continued
exertion or endeavour, exertion bestowed on anything
(with the object in the loc., or as the first member
of a comp.; cf. कृत-प्˚); activity of will; activity,
action, act; great care, caution, care; difficulty; (in
philosophy) active effort of three kinds, viz. engaging
in any act, prosecuting it, and completing it; (in
grammar) effort in uttering, effort or movement of
the mouth or breath in the production of articulate
utterance, mode of articulation, (also आस्य-प्र-
यत्न; distinguished into आभ्यन्तर-प्˚, inter-
nal effort, and वाह्य-प्˚, external effort); प्रयत्-
नेन, प्रयत्नात्, प्रयत्नैस्, प्रयत्न-तस्, ind.
with especial effort, with particular care or pains,
diligently, carefully, earnestly, zealously, with all one's
might; particularly, especially; with difficulty, hardly,
scarcely.
—प्रयत्न-प्रेक्षणीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to
be seen with an effort, hardly visible.
—प्रयत्न-
मुक्तासन, अस्, आ, अम्, quitting a seat with difficulty,
rising with difficulty from a seat.
—प्रयत्न-वत्, आन्,
अती, अत्, one who endeavours or makes effort, one
who directs his whole attention and care towards
anything, assiduous, enterprising, persevering.

प्रयम् प्र-यम्, cl. 1. P. -यच्छति, -यन्तुम्,
to hold out towards, offer; to present, bestow, grant,
give (with dat., loc., or gen. of the person and acc.
of the thing; in Ṛg-veda VII. 75, 2, with acc. of
the person and dat. of the thing); to give in mar-
[]
riage; to give up, deliver, restore, return; to pay,
discharge (a debt); to restrain, check, control.

प्र-यत, अस्, आ, अम्, restrained, well governed,
self-subdued, keeping the organs of sense under con-
trol; submissive; careful, prudent; zealous, intent
(on devotion); pure; (अस्), m. a holy or pious
person, one purified by austerity and mortification.
—प्रयत-त्व, अम्, n. self-control, purity, holiness.
—प्रयत-दक्षिण, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. one who
has made presents (to the priests officiating at a sa-
crifice; Sāy. = येन ऋत्विग्भ्यो दक्षिणा दत्ताः).
—प्रयत-परिग्रह-द्वितीय, अस्, m. accompa-
nied by a pious or chaste wife.
—प्रयतात्मन्
(˚त-आत्˚), आ, आ, अ, restrained in mind, pious-minded,
devout in spirit, pious, ascetic.

प्र-यात, अस्, आ, अम्, gone towards, advanced;
gone away, gone to a distance, gone, removed,
departed; deceased, dead; (अस्), m. an invasion,
[]
attack; a steep rock, precipice; (wrongly for प्र-
पात.)

प्र-यति, इस्, f., Ved. offering, presenting; a gift,
oblation; effort, exertion, endeavour; will, intention.

प्र-यन्तृ, ता, त्री, तृ, Ved. one who offers or
presents, a giver, bringer.

प्र-याम, अस्, m. checking, restraining; dearth,
scarcity, dearness; competition of buyers in conse-
quence of scarcity; length (either of space or time).

प्र-याम्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be checked or con-
trolled.

प्रयस् 1. प्र-यस्, cl. 4. 1. P. -यस्यति, -य-
सति, -यसितुम्, to endeavour, labour, strive after
(with dat.).

प्रयस् 2. प्रयस्, अस्, n. (fr. rt. 1. प्री), Ved.
pleasure, enjoyment, delight; an object of enjoy-
ment, delicate or dainty food, refreshing draught or
beverage; a sacrifice; प्रयांसि नदीनाम्, the re-
freshing waters of rivers (Sāy. = नदीनाम् प्रीणयि-
त्रीणि जलानि); (आस्, आस्, अस्), valuable, precious (?).
—प्रयस्-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. having or bestow-
ing pleasant food, offering refreshing food (Sāy. =
हविर्-लक्षणान्न-वत्); (अत्), n., N. of a Sā-
man; प्रयस्वन्तो ऽत्रयः, N. of the authors of
the hymn Ṛg-veda V. 20.
—१. प्रयो-ग, अस्, आ,
अम् (for 2. प्र-योग see p. 640, col. 1), Ved.
coming to a meal; (अस्), m., N. of a Ṛṣi with
the patronymic Bhārgava, author of the hymn Ṛg-
veda VIII. 91.

प्रायस्, ind. for the most part, mostly; commonly,
usually, frequently, oftentimes, generally, nearly; in all
probability, most likely, abundantly, largely.
—प्रायो-
देवता, f. the most usually worshipped deity.

प्र-यास, अस्, m. effort, exertion, labour, pains,
endeavour; प्रयासेन, with effort, diligently; अ-
प्रयासेन, without any exertion, without effort or
difficulty.
—प्रयास-भाज्, क्, क्, क्, capable of exer-
tion or fatigue, active, energetic.
प्रयास प्र-यास. See 1. प्र-यस्, col. 2.

प्रायास प्रा-यास, अस्, m., Ved. another
form for प्र-यास, q. v.

प्रयस्त, अस्, आ, अम् (probably connected with 2.
प्रयस्), seasoned, dressed with sauces and condiments.

प्रया 1. प्र-या, cl. 2. P. -याति, -यातुम्, to
go forwards, proceed onwards, advance, progress; to
go forth, go away, depart: Caus. -यापयति, -यि-
तुम्, to cause to proceed: Desid. -यियासति, to wish
to advance.

2. प्र-या, आस्, f. (or m. ?), Ved. rushing upon,
assailing, an attack, assault; (Sāy.) an attacking or
assailing force.

प्राय प्राय, अस्, m. (fr. rt. 5. इ with प्र),
setting out or starting (for a battle, Ved.; Sāy. =
प्र-वेश, entering, or = युद्ध, battle); going
away, departure, departure from life, seeking death
by fasting, sitting down and fasting to death (as a
religious or penitentiary act, or, like the practice of
sitting in Dharnā, to enforce compliance with a de-
mand; often used in connection with rt. 4. आस् or
with उप-विश्, e. g. प्रायम् आस्महे, we sit down
seeking death by fasting; but in such examples
प्रायम् may perhaps be regarded as the indeclinable
participle of rt. 5. इ with प्र; cf. प्रयोपवेश);
principal part, largest portion, plurality, majority,
majority of cases, general rule, abundance, plenty,
excess, (when used at the end of adj. comps. often
translatable by ‘in most cases,’ ‘for the most part,’
‘as a general rule,’ ‘generally,’ ‘well nigh,’ ‘almost,’
‘nearly,’ e. g. दण्ड-प्˚, one who generally inflicts
punishment; जित-प्˚, almost conquered; cf. आर्य-
प्˚, गत-प्˚, दुःख-प्˚, संस्तुत-प्˚, सिद्ध-प्˚:
or translatable by ‘abounding in,’ ‘much,’ ‘exceed-
ing,’ ‘abundant,’ e. g. शालि-प्˚, abounding in rice;
cf. हिंसा-प्˚: or by ‘like,’ ‘resembling,’ e. g. अमृत-
प्राय, अस्, आ, अम्, like nectar); a stage or condition
of life (as youth, age, &c.); (अम्), n. sin (?); प्रा-
येण, ind. for the most part, in most cases, mostly,
commonly, as a rule; in all probability, probably,
likely; much more, much rather.
—प्राय-गत,
अस्, आ, अम्, near departure from life, nigh unto death.
—प्राय-चित्त, प्राय-चित्ति, see Scholiast on Pāṇ.
VI. 1, 157, and cf. प्रायश्-चित्त, &c.
—प्राय-
दर्शन, अम्, n. a common or ordinary pheno-
menon.
—प्राय-भव, अस्, आ, अम्, being com-
monly the case, usually met with.
—प्राय-विधा-
यिन्, ई, इनी, इ, resolved to die of starvation.
—प्रा-
यश्-चित्त, अम्, n. (प्राय + चित्त with श् euphonically
inserted), an expiation, expiatory act, atonement,
penance, satisfaction, compensation, indemnification,
amends; (अस्, आ, अम्), belonging to or included in
an expiation or atonement, expiatory.
—प्रायश्चित्त-
तत्त्व, अम्, n., N. of a work by Raghu-nandana.
—प्रायश्चित्त-दीपिका, f., N. of a work on ritual
by Vara-da.
—प्रायश्चित्त-पद्धति, इस्, f., N. of
a work by Kāma-deva.
—प्रायश्चित्त-रत्न, अम्,
n., N. of a work by Kamalākara-bhaṭṭa.
—प्रायश्-
चित्त-विधि, इस्, m. a prescribed rule of penance or
expiation.
—प्रायश्चित्त-विवेक, अस्, m., N. of a
work by Śūla-pāṇi on expiatory ceremonies.
—प्रा-
यश्-चित्ति, इस्, इस्, इ (प्राय + चित्ति with श् euphoni-
cally inserted), expiating, atoning; (इस्), f. expiation,
atonement, penance.
—प्रायश्चित्तिक, अस्, ई, अम्,
expiating, expiatory, performing penance (?); expi-
able.
—प्रायश्चित्तिन्, ई, इनी, इ, one who does
penance or has to make expiation.
—प्रायश्चित्ति-
मत्, आन्, अती, अत्, making atonement, expiating,
performing penance.
—१. प्रायश्चित्तीय, Nom. A.
प्रायश्चित्तीयते, -यितुम्, to have to expiate, to be
obliged to perform penance.
—२. प्रायश्चित्तीय,
अस्, आ, अम्, relating to expiation or penance, expia-
tory.
—प्रायश्चित्तीय-ता, f. obligation to make an
atonement.
—प्रायश्चित्तेन्दु-शेखर (˚त-इन्˚),
अस्, m., N. of a work by Kāśī-nātha on expiatory
ceremonies.
—प्रायोपगमन (˚य-उप्˚), अम्, n.
going to meet death, seeking death (by abstaining
from food).
—प्रायोपविष्ट (˚य-उप्˚), अस्, आ,
अम्, or प्रायोपवेशिन्, ई, इनी, इ, one who sits
down in expectation of death, one who calmly
awaits the approach of death (by abstaining from
food), one who sits in Dharnā to compel compliance
with a demand; [cf. प्रायोपवेश.]
—प्रायोप-
वेश (˚य-उप्˚), अस्, m. or प्रायोपवेशन, अम्, n.
or प्रायोपवेशनिका, f. abstaining from food and
awaiting in a sitting posture the approach of death,
[]
(this corresponds with the practice prevalent in some
parts of India of sitting in Dharnā at the door of a
house to extort a boon or gain a point which cannot
be accomplished by other means; the person so
sitting observes a strict fast till his object is obtained,
and if he dies in the process the sin falls on the
householder who refuses compliance with his de-
mand.)
—प्रायोपेत (˚य-उप्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, prepared
to die, resolved to die (by abstaining from food).

प्र-याण, अम्, n. setting out, departing, setting
forth, starting (on a journey); going forth, going to
a distance, journey, march; the march of an army,
attack, invasion; going, motion, progress; departure,
death [cf. प्राण-प्˚]; beginning, commencement;
the hind part or haunch of a horse or other animal,
the crupper (?) ; the back of a horse, the rider's seat.
—प्रयाण-काल, अस्, m. time of departure, death.
—प्रयाण-पुरी, f., N. of a town.
—प्रयाण-
भङ्ग, अस्, m. the breaking or suspending of a
journey, a halt.
—प्रयाणार्ह (˚ण-अर्˚), अस्, आ,
अम्, worthy of death, deserving death.
प्रयाण प्र-याण, &c. See 1. प्र-या, col. 2.

प्रायण, अस्, आ, अम्, going away, going, going
well (Ved.); (अम्), n. entrance, beginning, com-
mencement; the course or path of life; going for
protection, taking refuge; departure from life, death,
voluntary death, (प्रायणं कृ, to court death);
a kind of food prepared with milk.
—प्रायणान्त
(˚ण-अन्˚), अस्, m. the end of life; (अम्), ind. till
death, unto death.

प्रयाणक, अम्, n. a journey, march; going,
motion; अ-प्रयाणक, the suspension of a journey,
halting, a halt.

प्र-याणीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be gone forward or
advanced.

प्रायणीय, अस्, आ, अम्, belonging or relating to
the entrance or commencement, introductory, ini-
tiatory; (अस्), m., scil. याग or कर्म-विशेष, an
introductory libation at a Soma sacrifice; scil. अति-
रात्र, the first day of a Soma sacrifice lasting for
several days; (अम्), n., scil. अहन्, the first day of a
Soma sacrifice lasting for several days.

प्र-यातव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be gone forward or
advanced, to be marched or proceeded; to be attacked.

प्र-यातृ, ता, त्री, तृ, one who goes forward,
going, able to go or fly.

प्र-यापण or प्र-यापन, अम्, n. causing to
go forwards, sending; expelling, driving away.

प्र-यापणीय or प्र-यापनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be
caused to go forwards, to be sent away, to be sent.

प्र-यापित, अस्, आ, अम्, caused to go forwards,
driven or sent away, made to go or pass away.

प्र-यापिन्, ई, इणी or इनी, इ, causing to go for-
wards, sending forwards, causing to go, sending,
sending away.

प्र-याप्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be caused to go for-
wards, to be sent away.

प्र-याप्यमाण or प्र-याप्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्,
being caused to go forwards, being sent or made
to go, being caused to pass away.

प्र-यामन्, अ, n., Ved. going forwards, setting
out (Sāy. = प्र-गमन).

प्र-यायिन्, ई, इणी, इ, going forwards, advancing,
marching, going, driving, riding.

प्र-यास्यत्, अन्, अती, or अन्ती, अत्, about to go
forwards, about to go or depart, going.

प्र-यियासत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, wishing to go forth,
desirous of setting out.
प्र-यियु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. used for driving (as a horse).

प्रयाच् प्र-याच्, cl. 1. P. A. -याचति, -ते,
याचितुम्, to ask for, beg, solicit, request.

प्र-याचक, अस्, इका, अम्, asking, requesting,
begging, imploring.

प्र-याचन, अम्, n. asking, requesting, begging,
imploring.

प्रयु प्र-यु, cl. 2. P., 9. P. A. -यौति, -यु-
नाति, -युनीते, -यवितुम्, to disjoin, sever, separate.

प्र-युत, अस्, आ, अम्, joined, combined, united;
disjoined, separated; (अस्), m., N. of a Deva-gan-
dharva; (अम्), n. a million.
—प्रयुतेश्वर-तीर्थ
(˚त-ईश्˚), अम्, n., N. of a place of pilgrimage.
प्रयुत प्र-युत. See under प्र-यु, p. 639.

प्र-युति, इस्, f., Ved. separation from, absence;
thoughtlessness.

प्र-योतृ, ता, त्री, तृ, Ved. one who disjoins or
separates, severing, separating.
प्रयोतृ प्र-योतृ. See under प्र-यु, p. 639.

प्रयुज् 1. प्र-युज्, cl. 7. A. -युङ्क्ते, -योक्-
तुम्, to join to, harness, yoke; to make use of, use,
employ; to apply; to bestow, grant, give, lend; to
impose, inflict on (with loc. or gen. of the person);
to put in front; to appoint, invest (in an office),
install; to instigate, impel, direct towards; to cast,
hurl, throw (a missile); to conduct; to perform,
practise; to befit, become, be fitting or appropriate:
Caus. -योजयति, -यितुम्, to use, employ; exact
(interest, Manu III. 112); to perform, practise.

2. प्र-युज्, क्, क्, क्, joining, connected with (literally
or figuratively, as a cause, motive, &c.); (क्), f.,
Ved. a team of horses; impulse, motive, cause;
[]
acquiring, acquisition; प्रयुजां हवींषि or प्र-
युग्-घवींषि, Ved., N. of twelve oblations, one of
which is to be offered in each month.

प्र-युक्त, अस्, आ, अम्, joined to, harnessed, yoked;
used, employed; applied; inflicted upon; appointed,
nominated; associated or connected with; endowed
with, possessing (as an attribute &c.); resulting from,
consequent on, produced by, arising from, occasioned
by; compact, closely united; abstracted, lost in
meditation; lent (as money); asleep?; (अम्), n. a
cause.
—प्रयुक्त-संस्कार, अस्, आ, अम्, to which
polish has been applied, polished (as a gem).

प्र-युग, अम्, n. regarded as the original form
of प्रüग, q. v.

प्र-युज्य, ind. having used or employed; having
applied; having connected; having acted or behaved
to or towards.

प्र-युज्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being used or em-
ployed, being applied, &c.; being united or con-
nected with.

प्र-युञ्जान, अस्, आ, अम्, joining, adding; em-
ploying, using; appointing, deputing; performing,
doing.

प्र-योक्तव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be used or employed;
to be applied, applicable, suitable; to be exhibited
or represented (as a drama); to be hurled or thrown
(as a missile); to be uttered or pronounced.

प्र-योक्तृ, ता, त्री, तृ, one who employs or
applies, one who makes use of, one who uses, using,
employing; one who performs or directs, an exe-
cuter; one who stirs up or excites; an instigator;
the agent of an action; lending, a money-lender;
one who exhibits or represents (a drama); one who
shoots or sends (an arrow); one who recites, a reciter.
